name: @projexlight/sdk-tenant-lifecycle
summary: Tenant lifecycle state machine for ProjexCloud: provisioned → trial → active → suspended ↔ active, plus offboarding → offboarded with a default 30-day grace clock. Owns sandbox creation (sanitized sub-pool spin-up for support / testing) and the post-offboard shred chain. Refuses invalid transitions; emits one event per legal transition for downstream SDKs (vault, meter, pool-router, billing) to react.

endpoints.description: Suspend a tenant. Requires reason. Refuses if not in active|trial. Active sessions revoked + writes rejected at the gateway.
Reinstate a suspended tenant back to its prior state. Refuses if not in suspended.
Begin offboarding. Sets status=offboarding + deadline_at (default now + 30d). Grace period during which tenant data can still be exported.
Spin up a sanitized sandbox sub-pool under the calling tenant. Used for support reproductions / testing; PII masked per sanitization_policy.
Read current lifecycle state + transition history + (if offboarding) the deadline_at clock.

events.name: tenant.lifecycle.transitioned.v1
events.description: Any legal state transition. Carries old_state, new_state, reason, actor_id.

events.name: tenant.suspended.v1
events.description: Tenant moved to suspended. Gateway middleware uses this to reject writes.

events.name: tenant.reinstated.v1
events.description: Tenant moved back to its prior active state.

events.name: tenant.lifecycle.sandbox.created.v1
events.description: Sandbox sub-pool spun up. Carries parent_tenant_id + sanitization_policy + expires_at.

events.name: tenant.offboarded.v1
events.description: Grace period elapsed; tenant.status flipped to offboarded; downstream SDKs (vault.shred, meter.purge, pool-router.detach, payment.detach-methods) fan out to scrub the tenant's footprint.

events.name: tenant.offboard.requested.v1
events.description: Offboard initiated; tenant.status now offboarding. Grace clock started.

models.description: Append-only log of every legal state transition per tenant. Forensic source for offboarding-window disputes.
Sandbox sub-pool registry: parent_tenant_id, sanitization_policy, sub_tenant_id, expires_at, status.
Open offboarding clock: requested_at, deadline_at, requested_by, completion_at.

hooks.name: suspendTenant
hooks.description: Service function — requires reason. Idempotent: suspending an already-suspended tenant is a no-op.

hooks.name: reinstateTenant
hooks.description: Service function — only legal from suspended.

hooks.name: offboardTenant
hooks.description: Service function — starts the 30-day grace clock. deadline_at parameter optional (default now+30d).

hooks.name: createSandboxTenant
hooks.description: Spins a sandbox sub-pool with the requested sanitization policy.

hooks.name: startOffboardDeadlineScheduler
hooks.description: Background worker that fires at the deadline to flip offboarding → offboarded and emit tenant.offboarded.v1.

scenarios.title: Suspend a tenant for non-payment
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator-triggered (projexcloud-admin Tenants page) or workflow-triggered when sdk-billing's dunning advance hits the suspend threshold.
scenarios.example_code:
import { suspendTenant } from '@projexlight/sdk-tenant-lifecycle';
const state = await suspendTenant(tenant_id, 'non-payment after 60d grace', operator_id);
scenarios.expected_outcome: tenant.status='suspended'. Emits tenant.lifecycle.transitioned.v1 + tenant.suspended.v1. Gateway middleware now rejects writes for this tenant with 423 Locked.

scenarios.title: Reinstate after customer pays the overdue balance
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer makes good on the overdue balance; the dunning workflow auto-reinstates.
scenarios.expected_outcome: tenant.status reverts to active. Emits tenant.reinstated.v1. Gateway resumes normal write flow within Redis TTL invalidation.

scenarios.title: Customer requests offboard; 30-day grace before shred
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer ends contract. Default 30-day grace lets them export everything; can be tightened (e.g. immediate shred for regulatory holds) or extended via the deadline_at parameter.
scenarios.example_code:
import { offboardTenant } from '@projexlight/sdk-tenant-lifecycle';
const state = await offboardTenant(tenant_id, operator_id, new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86_400_000));
scenarios.expected_outcome: tenant.status='offboarding'; offboard_request row created. Emits tenant.offboard.requested.v1. Background scheduler watches deadline_at; on hit, transitions to offboarded + emits tenant.offboarded.v1 which fans out to every other SDK's shred handler.

scenarios.title: Spin up a sanitized sandbox for support reproduction
scenarios.when_to_use: Support engineer needs to reproduce a customer bug against a copy of their data with PII masked. Sandbox lives for a limited window then auto-tears down.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sandbox sub-tenant created under the parent. PII masked per policy; secrets redacted. Emits tenant.lifecycle.sandbox.created.v1. Auto-shredded at expires_at.

scenarios.title: Background scheduler flips offboarding → offboarded at the deadline
scenarios.when_to_use: Production deployment. The scheduler is the source of truth for when shred happens — no manual flip required.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Worker polls offboard_request rows; when deadline_at < now, transitions tenant + emits tenant.offboarded.v1. Downstream SDKs each fan out their shred handlers. Audit chain shows the full timeline for forensic / dispute resolution.

compliance_posture.notes: Grace period default 30 days satisfies GDPR Art-17 'without undue delay' for non-EU jurisdictions; configurable to 0 days for regulatory-hold cases (immediate shred) or 90 days for tenants with custom contract terms. Transition log retained 7 years post-offboard to satisfy SOX + dispute resolution.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per sandbox spin-up + per day of sandbox lifetime
